scope: Independent real keyboard, pointer, bilingual, standard/CVD, and screen-reader sessions for the Phase5 Rules UI v4 exact-shape correction. This gate defines external evidence only and changes no product, authority, rules, threshold, or exposure state.

future_targeted16_ta_prerequisite.policy: No external session may start or receive PASS/FAIL until a future targeted16 independent TA manual is byte-bound and validates PASS. This gate does not reference or predict a nonexistent SHA.

future_device_evidence_required: Pseudonymous device ID, manufacturer/model, physical display dimensions/density, OS build, keyboard layout, pointing device model, app binary SHA, configuration SHA, and session timestamps.
At least one real-input session per locale on each platform family and at least one session on every device slot.
Synthetic events, automation-only input, remote macro tools, and emulator-only devices do not count as real input.

future_configuration_evidence_required: Exact screen-reader version/build, speech synthesizer and voice/locale, verbosity settings, browse/focus mode, OS accessibility settings, and output transcript.
The participant must be a regular user of the assigned screen-reader family; moderator-only inspection does not count.

protocol_catalog.acceptance: Opening the group-choice dialog through real keyboard input shows no selected/armed action, emits no authority request, and performs no submission.
Tab/arrow traversal moves the independent leading focus chevron in authority order without arming, selecting, or submitting.
One activation of Choose solids arms only, exposes the enclosed check-diamond and exact actor/action copy, and emits zero submission requests.
Moving focus to confirm simultaneously exposes leading focus chevron, armed-row enclosed check-diamond, and confirm double-frame bent enter-arrow as three distinct shapes.
One separate confirm activation submits the exact armed action once; input/request trace contains exactly one submit and matching authority request identity.
Escape, focus loss, timeout, resume, and navigation away clear or preserve state only as contracted and never submit.
Key repeat, stale revision, actor/action drift, and ACK mismatch never duplicate submission; stale arm clears and current authority must be reacquired.
Opening and hovering through real pointer input causes no selection, arm, confirm, authority request, or submission.
One click on Choose solids arms only and exposes exact actor/action copy plus enclosed check-diamond with zero submission request.
A real double-click on an action row never crosses into confirm and emits zero submission requests.
After arming, one click inside the explicit confirm hit rectangle submits exactly once and matches the exact armed action/request identity.
Outside click, right-click, drag across a boundary, and application focus loss never submit or convert hover/focus into selection.
Clicks on every shared edge/gap activate at most the intended single row; no action/confirm overlap or adjacent-row cross activation occurs.
Stale revision, actor/action drift, and ACK mismatch clear the arm or remain blocked and never produce duplicate or wrong-action submission.
English armed and confirm visible copy names exact actor and exact action result with no generic wording, clipping, collision, or ellipsis.
Simplified-Chinese armed and confirm visible copy names exact actor and exact action result with correct punctuation, no generic wording, clipping, collision, or ellipsis.
English accessible names preserve the same exact actor/action meaning and state as visible armed/confirm copy without hidden authority additions.
Simplified-Chinese accessible names preserve the same exact actor/action meaning and state as visible armed/confirm copy without hidden authority additions.
In standard palette each CVD participant identifies focus, selected, and confirm from shape/text/luminance without using hue and does not count the Player HUD diamond.
In color_vision_safe palette each CVD participant identifies focus, selected, and confirm from the same independent shape inventory without using hue.
Standard and color_vision_safe sessions expose identical action order, copy, token roles, focus order, and submission behavior.
CVD participants do not confuse new focus/selected/confirm shapes with placement valid/invalid markers, submitting status, authority error, or Player HUD diamond.
On open, the screen reader announces dialog role, localized title/body, actor, revision, and no default selected/armed state.
Focus order is title/context then actions in exact authority order, followed by confirm only after arming; no hidden/unoffered/foundation action enters traversal.
Moving accessibility focus never announces selected/armed; first activation announces armed/selected while preserving a separate focused element.
Confirm control accessible name includes localized confirm intent, exact actor, and exact action result; role/state indicate enabled only for a fresh exact arm.
Cancel, stale revision, actor drift, submitting, and authority error changes are announced, focus is restored predictably, and no blocked action remains activatable.
Experienced VoiceOver users complete the full localized arm/confirm/cancel flow in English and Simplified Chinese with correct names, roles, states, and focus order.
Experienced NVDA users complete the full localized arm/confirm/cancel flow in English and Simplified Chinese with correct names, roles, states, and focus order.
Accessibility transcript has no duplicate submit announcement, silent focus move, stale accessible name, hidden action, or mismatch between visible and announced state.

item_result_contract.pass_policy: Every required subject result for the item is PASS and all required evidence bindings validate. No averaging, majority vote, waived critical error, inherited machine/TA PASS, or N/A is allowed.
item_result_contract.fail_policy: Any subject FAIL, wrong-action or duplicate submission, accidental submission, inaccessible required control, incorrect actor/action name, focus-order violation, color-only distinction, missing transcript/evidence, or protocol deviation makes the item FAIL and the overall external gate FAIL.
item_result_contract.not_run_policy: Any item or required subject result not executed remains NOT_RUN and prevents overall PASS. NOT_RUN may never be converted to PASS by machine evidence, moderator judgment, template generation, or design approval.

per_subject_session: Pseudonymous subject code, cohort/locale, consent receipt hash, independent moderator ID, device/configuration binding, app binary SHA, start/end timestamps, and protocol version SHA.
Raw keyboard or pointer event trace with monotonic timestamps, focused/armed/confirm state transitions, authority request count/identity, and observed outcome for real-input sessions.
Visible capture or lossless screenshots sufficient to bind bilingual copy and standard/CVD shapes without exposing personal data.
Screen-reader version/configuration plus time-aligned speech/accessibility transcript, focus events, accessible name/role/state, and participant observation for screen-reader sessions.
aggregate: Exact subject/session/item inventory, per-file SHA-256, and a stable ordered aggregate SHA-256.
Independent moderator sign-off and external review receipt; any missing file, hash, item, subject, device, locale, CVD type, or screen-reader family is fail-closed.

forbidden_changes_and_claims: No authority/rules/action inventory/order/request/ACK/idempotency/submission behavior implementation change is authorized by this gate.
No product source, shipping asset, threshold, placement overlay, visual token, copy, localization, screen-reader adapter, or exposure implementation change is authorized by this gate.
No contrast, type, shape-size/stroke, hit-target, safe-area, layout, performance, evidence, participant, device, or pass threshold may be relaxed.

No session is executed by creating this gate/template. No targeted16 TA pass, external-human pass, keyboard pass, pointer pass, CVD pass, localization pass, screen-reader pass, product exposure, Golden, M2, or Beta pass is claimed.
